summary: Master applied data analysis with our MS Excel course. Learn to tackle real-world business problems and enhance your decision-making skills effectively.
lede: Applied Data Analysis for Real-World Business Solutions Using Microsoft Excel shows you how to move from a business question to a clean dataset, reliable calculations, and evidence-based recommendations. You will use Power Query, PivotTables, Power Pivot, DAX measures, statistical methods, and dashboard design to prepare, analyse, and model business data. Practical exercises cover data-quality checks, KPI definitions, scenario modelling, relationship testing, and management reporting. You will also apply CRISP-DM principles to frame analysis, test assumptions, communicate trends clearly, and make your conclusions easier to trace and reproduce.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who already use spreadsheets and need to produce more reliable, repeatable, and decision-focused data analysis for business operations.
modules: Business Questions and Excel Data Foundations
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop with a recent desktop version of Microsoft Excel that includes Power Query, PivotTables, Power Pivot, and the Analysis ToolPak where available. No coding or programming experience is required. Training datasets and practice templates are provided, and you may optionally bring a sanitized business dataset for selected exercises. Do not use confidential, personal, or commercially sensitive records.
